name: enrich
description: Improve a draft prompt in place: ctrl+x e runs a quick pass that tidies it, and the same chord puts your original back.

quickModel.title: Quick-pass model
quickModel.description: The model the quick pass runs on: an alias (sonnet, haiku, opus) or a full model id.

quickEffort.title: Quick-pass effort
quickEffort.description: How hard the quick pass thinks. low keeps it to a few seconds.

timeoutMs.title: Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Give up on a pass after this long; your draft stays as it was.

quickAction.title: Quick-pass action
quickAction.description: The engine keybinding action the quick-pass chord is bound to. Plugins cannot register their own actions, so the chord borrows one whose only handler lives inside the diff dialog. Change it only if a Claude Code update breaks the default.
